'''Sorotarr VI''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GG9" /> located in the [[Sorotarr system/Legends|Sorotarr system]], a part of the [[Yushan sector/Legends|Yushan sector]]<ref name="EAOC Sorotarr" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="WesternReaches" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC Sorotarr" /> It was the site of the establishment known as [[the Game]] and was a favorite destination for [[Gambler/Legends|gamblers]]. Similarly to worlds such as [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]] and [[Harloen]], by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Sorotarr VI was commonly frequented by people such as corporate executives; Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admirals]], and [[Noble/Legends|nobles]]; and dishonest individuals, who were all traveling incognito and were seeking out entertainment.<ref name="GG9" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sorotarr VI was mentioned in the [[1993]] [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'' that was written by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]].<ref name="GG9" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] placed the Sorotarr [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Sorotarr VI, in grid square K-17.<ref name="TEA" />
